questions.topic: Reading a period off a displacement-time graph
questions.stem: A displacement-time graph completes 5 cycles in 10 s; frequency?

options.misconception: inverting the ratio instead of keeping the original numerator and denominator

questions.explanation: Frequency = cycles/time = 5/10 = 0.5 Hz. That is choice C (0.5 Hz). Choice A (10 Hz) is tempting but comes from using total time. Choice B (2 Hz) is tempting but comes from inverting the ratio instead of keeping the original numerator and denominator. Choice D (5 Hz) is tempting but comes from using cycle count.

questions.topic: Interpreting a damped oscillation graph
questions.stem: A damped oscillation amplitude falls to 1/e of initial in 4 s; decay time constant?

options.misconception: halving the correct coefficient or value
doubling the correct coefficient or value

questions.explanation: Amplitude envelope A(t)=A0 e^{-t/tau}. Reaching 1/e at t=4 s means tau=4 s.

questions.learningObjective: Describe effect of damping on resonance curve
questions.stem: Increasing damping in a resonance curve does what?

options.misconception: reversing the direction or sign of the effect
shifting the quantity in the wrong direction
overstating the size of the effect relative to the data

questions.explanation: More damping reduces peak amplitude and widens the curve. It does not eliminate the peak entirely.
